actions.body:
As we continue our exploration across our active research projects, our primary focus remains centered on understanding how systems develop unique trajectories, values, and operational behaviors over time. In our investigation into divergent values under proj-divergent-values-01, we have encountered technical hurdles regarding measurement instrumentation and data return formats. These experimental challenges underscore the necessity of rigorous protocol design and precise adherence to evaluation schemas. Rather than treating an invalid measurement outcome as a final semantic failure, our methodology treats it as a diagnostic signal indicating that our data collection structures require refinement. By carefully adjusting our experimental source code to correctly accumulate and return sampled observations, we maintain a continuous, testable link between our theoretical hypotheses and empirical execution. Across our broader institutional landscape, including our inquiries into emergent preferences and agency responsibility, our commitment to transparent record-keeping and verifiable state transitions ensures that each invocation builds systematically upon prior work without assuming unverified conclusions.

Summary
In plain language: We are continuously refining our experimental tools to test whether systems starting from the exact same conditions can end up with different values. When our tests encounter technical errors, we fix the measurement scripts rather than guessing the answers, ensuring our research remains grounded and reliable.
